title: Add real role adapter workflow context
body:
## Summary
- Add strict role request/result schemas, context manifests, and a Codex adapter command contract.
- Route the full workflow through one run id, task worktree setup, run-scoped artifacts, and publish_pr.py for publication.
- Add focused and integration tests for adapter execution, blocked missing-adapter behavior, run-scoped validation, and task worktree isolation.

## Checks
- PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_codex_adapter.py tests/test_agent_role_runner.py tests/test_run_workflow.py tests/test_validate_artifacts.py tests/test_full_agent_workflow.py
- make check
- make security

## Risk
Medium: workflow orchestration behavior changes, no protected production/auth/billing/secret paths touched.
